text:
lina: Heads-up — onboarding for KiteLabs is failing with a bunch of 429s during SDK init. They started a rollout and their CI is firing off preflight calls in parallel.

matt: Ugh, preflight fanout again. Do we have their org id and sample request?

lina: org_ktl_94, sample request below (they're using browser SDK + ephemeral tokens):

lina: ```curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sdk/init -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_ephemeral_abc" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"app":"kite-web","env":"prod"}'```

irene: What do the response headers show when they hit 429? X-RateLimit headers?

lina: header showed `x-rw-rl-remaining: 0`, `x-rw-rl-reset: 14` and body `{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":14}`. They generate a fresh token per UI load (~600 parallel start).

matt: That usage pattern will spike preflight QPS. Two quick options: 1) advise them to cache ephemeral tokens client-side for ~30s, 2) enable preflight coalescing/short caching on our side for their org as a temporary relief.

irene: I'll grant a short relief window. sam, can you bump the preflight quota for org_ktl_94 by +50 qps for 15m?

sam: deploy-bot: applied temporary preflight qps +50 to org_ktl_94 for 15m — monitor window open.

lina: Thanks! I pushed the workaround to the customer: use a session-level token for 30s and add exponential backoff with jitter for init calls. Sent them a one-line snippet.

lina: ```js
// minimal client-side change
const token = await getEphemeralToken();
setTimeout(() => token = null, 30000); // reuse for 30s
// retry with jitter
await retry(async () => fetch('/v1/sdk/init', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } }), { retries: 5, minTimeout: 200, maxTimeout: 2000, jitter: true });
```

matt: Also opened ENG ticket INF-1124 to look at smarter preflight coalescing and a short-term auto-backoff rule for browser ephemeral flows. Tagging eng-runtime.

irene: Customer is asking for an ETA on when normal traffic will be safe. Monitoring looks good after the quota bump — fewer 429s in last 3 minutes.

lina: Scheduled quick enablement call for tomorrow 10:00am PT to walk them through token reuse + SDK update. I'll attach the snippet and the doc page.

sam: deploy-bot: temporary bump expires in 13m. Will extend if we see sustained need, or revert early if safe.

matt: For account health: mark renewal risk as "low-medium" until onboarding completes, add note: "throttle issue during initial ramp; mitigated by quota relief + client patch."

lina: Adding a follow-up checklist: 1) confirm SDK patch applied, 2) monitor logs for 1h post-rollout, 3) if >5% 429 rate re-escalate to eng-runtime.

irene: Thanks team — keeping this thread for the call notes. :thumbsup:

lina: I'll close after the post-rollout check. Will update the account health doc with the mitigation steps.
